request.description:
Updates an existing Confluence page with new content. This corresponds to the updatePageByContent method in PageArea.java.

Required parameters:
- id: The ID of the page to update
- status: Page status ("draft" or "current")
- title: Updated page title (optional)
- version.number: Current version number + 1
- version.message: Update comment
- body.value: The updated HTML content

The method processes multiple Content entities and combines them into the page body, similar to createPageFromContent but for updates.

request.description:
Updates an existing Confluence page using a template with variable substitution. This corresponds to the updatePageFromTemplate method in PageArea.java.

Required parameters:
- id: The ID of the page to update
- templateId: The ID of the template to use (referenced in environment)
- status: Page status ("draft" or "current")
- title: Updated page title (optional)
- version.number: Current version number + 1
- version.message: Update comment
- variables: Key-value pairs for template variable substitution

The method retrieves the template, substitutes variables, and updates the page content.

Example variables:
- question: "What is Krista?"
- answer: "Updated answer with more details"
